one_sentence_story: Every night two brainstem chemicals lock your muscles so you stay safe during dreams, and sleep paralysis just means your mind woke up ten seconds before that lock clicked off.
so_what_for_you: If you wake up still parked in neutral, do not strain. Breathe slowly and wiggle one toe so your dream brake clicks cleanly off.
